name: Wheat bran, crude
source: Proximate composition (per kg): water 99 g, protein 156 g, fat 43 g, ash 58 g, carbohydrate by difference 644 g, typical of crude wheat bran (USDA FoodData Central pattern).
notes: Same conversion method as wheat-grain. Bran concentrates the grain's phosphorus and magnesium, reflected in a higher mineral share of its (larger) ash fraction than either the whole grain or white flour.
